name: boat_on_accent_uncovers_clash
ref: spec §2.5/§2.9: a Boat on an accent may not uncover a clash
note: The Rock at (4,8) is the only thing between Rose/1 (4,5) and Jasmine/2 (4,11); a Boat on it removes both and leaves them facing each other. The Boat on the Knotweed elsewhere uncovers nothing and stays legal.
